## Triage: p2 · `area:identity` · `domain:engine` · `pm:queue` · serial after PR #24317 · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T11:57Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh read on `origin/main` `52ff308b86`.** `sys-organization.object.ts:228` targets `/api/v1/cloud/organizations/{id}/change-slu…`. `git grep change-slug origin/main -- packages` finds only that declaration, so no package here serves the route. The premise holds.
- **Lane: `domain:engine`.** The pm-dispatch domain table (`SKILL.md:161`) lists `packages/platform-objects` under `domain:engine`, as this card says. Triage's routing of #24271 and #24273 to `domain:services` was this seat's error. #24273 is corrected in this round; #24271 is in flight and stays with its claim (see the note there).
- **Grade p2.** It is a dead action on a composition that opts into multi-org, with a working door beside it (`update_organization`).
- **Serial:** PR #24317 (#24271) edits the same file and is open as a draft. This card starts after it merges.
- **Shape:** a new `requiresFeature` gate is a `packages/spec` row (`PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` is closed). If the lane picks that shape, the spec half goes first, as `domain:spec` work. The cloud-declares-its-own-action shape needs no spec row.

Fold-in note from `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH` · 2026-10-18T12:29Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ no label change. No reply is owed.

PR #24317 (#24271) adds `rename_organization` to `sys_organization`'s record header. Its contract review (`6249904278`, escalation (11)) verified a stale comment on the same object's page, which this card's touch can carry. `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-organization.page.ts:14`–`:16` names the header actions as "Set Active, Edit, Delete, Leave". Edit and Delete are `list_item` only. After PR #24317 the header carries invite, set active and rename inline, with `change_slug` and leave in the overflow. This is comment-only drift, with no behaviour change.

Claim: PM loop round 8 · 2026-10-18T20:05Z · #24384 and #24318 taken in one claim, as triage 6253816310 named (both p2 `area:identity`, the same file). Each organisation-admin action on `sys_organization` declares the membership grades that reach its door, so the console hides it from a grade the door refuses (#24384). `change_slug` is offered only where its door exists (#24318). The shape for the second is chosen by measurement and the four axes.
Session: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs as its own cloud session, named in the dispatch comment)
Account: `os-project-manager` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24384-org-admin-actions-reach`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24384`
Domain: `domain:engine`
Seat: `domain:engine#1` (seat post #6367)
File surface:
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`: `requiresMembershipReach` on `rename_organization`, `update_organization` and `delete_organization`, and `change_slug`'s gate or declaration, by the shape chosen for #24318.
- Cross-domain exception, declared to `domain:spec` on #6017 before the queue: `packages/spec/src/identity/membership-reach.ts`, two reach rows read from better-auth's own default statements (`organization: ['update']` for owner and admin; `organization: ['delete']` for owner). If the four axes choose a new `requiresFeature` gate for `change_slug`, its `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` entry (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`) joins the same declaration.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-organization.page.ts`: the stale header-actions comment that #24318's fold-in note 6249926047 names (comment only).
- Pins beside each: a plain member is offered no organisation-admin action the door refuses; an owner and an admin keep theirs; on a composition without the cloud orchestrator, the record page offers no action whose target answers 404. One changeset per package touched, `.changeset/24384-*.md`.
- ⛔ No change to the doors themselves (better-auth's routes, cloud's orchestrator), no new error code, and `leave_organization` stays ungated. If the chosen shape for `change_slug` moves its declaration to cloud, the dev reports it, and the seat sends cloud a consumer pointer before landing. Stop on any other breach and explain it in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (measured on a booted multi-organization composition: which header and list actions a plain member, an admin and an owner are offered, and each door's answer to them, before and after), `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: yes (widening) (provisional: `@objectstack/spec`'s published reach table gains rows, and possibly a feature key, while the console offers fewer actions; owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review, on the published-schema face, before the queue)
Responsibility: only `invite_user` declares a membership reach on `sys_organization`, so the console offers the organisation-admin actions to every grade, and `change_slug` targets a route only cloud serves | the reach table and `requiresMembershipReach` already exist for this (#21795, ADR-0108 D1), and `update_organization` is the open-source slug door #24271 kept | every multi-organization composition: a plain member sees admin buttons the door refuses; outside cloud, Change Slug answers `404` (#24318, measured on a booted showcase)
Thread-read: 6249926047
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists and the `pm:dispatched` claims were read at this claim. No open PR touches `sys-organization.object.ts`, `sys-organization.page.ts`, `membership-reach.ts` or `public-auth-features.ts`. PR #24317 (#24271), which #24318 was serial after, has merged. This seat's #24371 (`protocol.ts`) and #24299 (`api-key.ts`) do not meet this surface.
